summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Arm Holdings plc, containing its quarterly financial results for the period ended June 30, 2026. It includes standard income statement and balance sheet data, segment revenue breakdown, and notes on related-party transactions and fair value measurements. There are no references to any merger, acquisition disposition, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is a routine periodic report of financial results and does not describe a special-situation corporate event.
